title: Functorial flat resolutions pass to sheaves on an essentially small site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an essentially small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with a symmetric monoidal closed structure whose tensor product is additive in each variable. Give $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathcal A)$ the sheafified tensor product of [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed]. In either category, an object is flat if tensoring with it on either side preserves short exact sequences. A functorial flat resolution means a functor with flat values together with a natural epimorphism from it to the identity functor. If $\mathcal A$ has a functorial flat resolution, then $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathcal A)$ has one.
